requirement: Internal HR tool for 80 employees. Leave requests and payroll records. Office hours only.
class: small internal CRUD app, no public surface, no HA stated

aws.note: The smallest honest shape. 80 internal users do not justify a CDN, a WAF or a cache tier.

gcp.note: Cloud Run + Cloud SQL is the documented minimum three-tier shape.

azure.note: Basic web app: App Service + Azure SQL. No gateway/WAF in the basic tier.

forbidden.edge-cache: 80 internal employees is not a CDN workload
forbidden.waf: internal tool behind the corporate boundary
forbidden.cache: leave requests and payroll at office-hours volume do not need a cache tier
